result.topic_en: Infinite product expansions in x with factors of the form (1 ± c x^4/π^4) and products over pairs of unequal integers m, n (all integers, or odd integers only) involving the expression m^4 − 6m^2n^2 + n^4.
result.transcription:
Setzen[?] n. x =

$x\left(1+\frac{4x^4}{4\pi^4}\right)\left(1+\frac{4x^4}{4\cdot 16\pi^4}\right)\left(1+\frac{4x^4}{4\cdot 81\pi^4}\right)\ldots$
$\left(1-\frac{x^4}{\pi^4}\right)\left(1-\frac{x^4}{16\pi^4}\right)\ldots$

$\times$ Prod. ex $\left(1-\frac{2(m^4-6m^2n^2+n^4)}{(mm+nn)^4 [-+(4mn)^4-]}\left(\frac{x}{\pi}\right)^4+\frac{x^8:\pi^8}{(mm+n)^4 [-+(4mn)^4-]}\right)$

Sumtis pro m, n omnibus numeris integris
inaequalibus.

[-$\left(1+\frac{4xx}{\pi\pi}\right)\left(1+\frac{4xx}{9\pi\pi}\right)$ &c $\left(1+\frac{4xx}{25\pi\pi}\right)\ldots$-]
$\left(1+\frac{4x^4}{\pi^4}\right)\left(1+\frac{4x^4}{81\pi^4}\right)\left(1+\frac{4x^4}{625[?]\pi^4}\right)\ldots$ 31

$\times$ Pr. ex $\left(1-\frac{2(m^4-6m^2n^2+n^4)}{(mm+nn)^4}\left(\frac{2x}{\pi}\right)^4+\frac{1}{(mm+nn)^4}\left(\frac{2x}{\pi}\right)^8\right)$

Sumtis pro m, n omnibus numeris imparibus
inaequalibus

methods.what: Infinite product expansion with factors (1 + x^4/(4k^4π^4)) and (1 − x^4/(k^4π^4)) times a double product over unequal integers m, n
Double product factor over all unequal integers m, n involving m^4 − 6m^2n^2 + n^4 and (m^2+n^2)^4
Analogous product over odd k with factors (1 + 4x^4/(k^4π^4)) times a double product over unequal odd m, n
